summary: Owns packet history and frame integrity tracking for dependency-descriptor frames.
responsibilities: Track first and last packet sequence numbers for frames.
Record packet receipt history in a circular bitset.
Check whether packets in a frame range are consecutive.
Track integrity state for a bounded window of frame numbers.

summary: Tracks packet boundaries and integrity state for one frame.

inner.summary: First packet extended sequence number for the frame when known.
Last packet extended sequence number for the frame when known.
Records whether all packets between start and end are present.
Packet receipt history used to verify consecutive packets.

summary: Updates frame packet boundaries and marks integrity when the complete sequence range is present.
summary_step: 1. Returns immediately when the frame already has integrity, treating later packets as duplicates.
2. Records start and end extended sequence numbers when dependency descriptor flags identify first or last packets in the frame.
3. When both boundaries are known, asks packet history whether the range is consecutive and marks the frame intact when it is.

summary: Clears frame integrity and packet boundary state.
Returns whether the frame has complete packet integrity.
Stores packet receipt state in a circular bitset over a bounded extended sequence range.

inner.summary: Base extended sequence number for bitset indexing.
Circular bitset storing packet receipt state.
Number of packet slots retained by the history.
Records whether the history has received its first packet.

summary: Constructs packet history with capacity rounded up to a multiple of 64.
Records a received packet sequence number in the bounded packet history.
summary_step: 1. Initializes base, last, and the first received bit on the first packet, backing the base up to keep early out-of-order packets in range.
2. Ignores packets older than the base and records in-range out-of-order packets when they are within retained history.
3. Clears missing packet bits between the previous last sequence and the new sequence, records the new packet, and advances last.

summary: Maps an extended sequence number to bitset word index and bit offset.
Sets or clears the packet receipt bit for an extended sequence number.
Reports whether every packet in an extended sequence range has been received.
summary_step: 1. Rejects reversed ranges and ranges that exceed retained packet history capacity.
2. Uses a single-word mask for ranges that fit in one bitset word.
3. Checks the first partial word, any wrapped middle words, and the final partial word for all received bits.

summary: Tracks frame integrity over a bounded rolling window of extended frame numbers.

inner.summary: Number of frame slots retained by the checker.
Base extended frame number for indexing.
Shared packet history used by frame slots.
Records whether the checker has received its first frame.

summary: Constructs a frame integrity checker with frame slots and shared packet history.
summary_step: 1. Allocates frame slots and a packet history with the requested capacities.
2. Assigns the shared packet history to every frame slot.
3. Resets each frame slot before returning the checker.

decl: func (fc *FrameIntegrityChecker) AddPacket(extSeq uint64, extFrameNum uint64, ddVal *dd.DependencyDescriptor)
summary: Adds a packet to packet history and updates integrity state for its extended frame number.
summary_step: 1. Records the packet sequence in shared packet history and initializes frame base and last on the first frame.
2. Ignores frames older than the base or outside the retained rolling frame window.
3. Updates existing frame slots for in-range old frames, or resets skipped frame slots before adding a packet to a newer frame and advancing last.

summary: Returns whether a retained frame number has complete packet integrity.
